messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend periods in Canada for 2023 (based on the federal statutory holidays and their observed dates):

| Holiday | Observed Date | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|---------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 2 (observed) | **Jan 1–3** (Sunday–Tuesday) |
| Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, etc.) | Feb 20 (Monday) | **Feb 18–20** (Saturday–Monday) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) | **Apr 7–8** (Friday–Saturday) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | **May 20–22** (Saturday–Monday) |
| Canada Day | Jul 3 (observed) | **Jul 1–3** (Saturday–Monday) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | **Sep 2–4** (Saturday–Monday) |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Monday) | **Oct 7–9** (Saturday–Monday) |
| Christmas | Dec 25 (Monday) | **Dec 23–25** (Saturday–Monday) |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | **Dec 26–27** (Tuesday–Wednesday) |

> **Note:** Some provinces have additional statutory holidays (e.g., Family Day in British Columbia on Feb 20, or St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador on Mar 17). If you’re targeting a specific province, let me know and I can adjust the list accordingly.
